Install SKaiNET

SKaiNET installs from Maven Central as a Kotlin Multiplatform BOM.

Prerequisites

You need a JDK 21 toolchain and Gradle.

implementation(platform("sk.ainet:skainet-bom:0.57.0"))

  • macOS and Linux are tier one.

  • Windows runs via the JVM target.

iOS targets

iOS additionally needs Xcode and the simulator runtime.

Verify the install

Run the smoke test to confirm tensors compute on your machine.
